title: Kano L-CNG Station
summary: An L-CNG refueling station with a 40-ton storage capacity can provide refueling services for tube-skid trailers as well as for individual vehicles, including heavy-duty trucks.

results: The completion of the project has addressed the demand for natural gas in the Kano region—specifically for power generation as well as for refueling passenger vehicles and heavy-duty trucks—thereby delivering significant social benefits.
